notes.title: Sign Up for the Machine Mind Playtest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/282acf4d1514176c5e90a74e0fcef569fbe6b84d.jpg[/img]

Want to be among the first to test new game features? We invite you to join the playtest of Machine Mind! This is a great chance to experience the gameplay before release, share your impressions, and help us make the game even better.

How to Join?
– Go to the game’s page on Steam and click the "Request Access" button
– Wait for a notification when the playtest access is granted
– Play and share your feedback!

Add Machine Mind to your wishlist and follow our social media to stay updated on the latest news:
[list]
[*] Discord: https://discord.gg/yxNxZ5Z8Ta
[*] X: https://x.com/TG_Indie
[/list]

notes.title: Machine Mind is in the top of the most popular demos at the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/86aea694320503ed7b2e5424e85d4c03df5b6efa.png[/img]

Machine Mind has made it into the top 20 most-played demos at the Steam Next Fest 2025!

The number of players who added Machine Mind to their wishlist reached 60,000, and on behalf of the entire development team, we thank you for playing the demo, adding the game to your wishlist, and supporting us with your feedback and reviews!

For more exciting news, check out the project's social media:

[/list]
